title: Campus Programme Manager, StartNet Vibe
location: Salem, with travel across Tamil Nadu
summary: Run Vibe Campus build nights and the Vibathon 2027 district qualifiers with our host colleges, from first call to finale.
outcome: Every host college runs its build nights on time, and its student teams reach the Vibathon 2027 district qualifiers with something built.
about:
StartNet Vibe takes college students from a first idea to a first company: build nights, hackathons, an academy and campus clubs, in Tamil and English. This season brings Vibe Campus build nights from December 2026, district qualifiers in January 2027 and the Vibathon 2027 state finale.

You will be the person our host colleges and their Institution's Innovation Councils call first.
responsibilities: Sign up and support host colleges, and agree dates, rooms and faculty leads with each one.
Plan and run build nights and district qualifiers: briefs, mentors, judges, logistics and the day itself.
Recruit and brief mentors and judges from StartNet's network.
Keep every registration and result in StartNet X, so the Founder Ledger counts what really happened.
Report each event's numbers within a week, against the targets we set together.
requirements: Three or more years running student, campus or community programmes, or events with many moving parts.
At ease speaking with principals, faculty and students, in Tamil and English.
Organised: you keep plans, budgets and checklists up to date without being asked.
Ready to travel to colleges across Tamil Nadu for much of the season.
niceToHave: You have organised or taken part in a hackathon.
Links with Institution's Innovation Councils or college incubators.

title: Events Manager, StartNet Connect
summary: Deliver the Connect flagships, Agentic AI Connect 2026 and Physical AI Connect 2027, and the Connect Circles between them.
outcome: Each Connect summit fills its room with the right founders, buyers and investors, and every partner gets the report we promised them.
about:
StartNet Connect helps working professionals become founders and helps startups find customers, capital and co-founders. Its sector summits have filled rooms in Salem and Coimbatore since 2024: GenAI Connect, D2C Connect and SaaS Connect. Next come Agentic AI Connect 2026 in Chennai and Physical AI Connect 2027.

You will own the summits end to end, with the brand lead and our partners.
responsibilities: Own each summit's plan, budget and run of show: venue, agenda, speakers, expo and volunteers.
Build the audience with the brand lead, and keep the invite list to the founders, buyers and investors each summit is for.
Look after sponsors and partners from contract to post-event report.
Run the monthly Connect Circles between summits.
Measure each event: registrations, attendance, meetings made and follow-ups, recorded in StartNet X.
requirements: Four or more years producing conferences, summits or B2B events of 300 people or more.
Strong vendor and budget management.
Calm on the day: you have run a live event where something went wrong.
Clear written and spoken English; Tamil is a strong advantage.
niceToHave: A network in Tamil Nadu's startup, GCC or IT community.
Experience with event registration and CRM tools.

title: Partnerships Manager
summary: Win and grow StartNet's partnerships with institutions, GCCs, CSR funders and district administrations.
outcome: Signed, dated partnerships that pay for founder programmes, each reported back to the partner against the Founder Ledger.
about:
Organisations that need founders pay for founders: colleges that want graduates who build companies, GCCs that want intrapreneurs and solved problems, CSR funders and districts that want outcomes they can measure. StartNet's ready-made offers include the District Ecosystem Programme, the Institution Partner Programme, lab sponsorship and Vibathon partnerships.

You will find these partners, shape the agreement with them and make sure they renew.
responsibilities: Build and work a pipeline of institutions, GCCs, CSR funders and government bodies.
Lead proposals and agreements with the founders and brand leads.
Hand each signed partnership to the delivery team with clear outcomes and dates.
Send partners their reports on time and plan renewals with them.
Keep the partner record on the site (signed, dated) accurate.
requirements: Five or more years in partnerships, institutional sales or CSR in India.
Proposals and agreements you have taken from first meeting to signature.
Comfortable with senior people in colleges, companies and government.
Excellent written English; Tamil for district and institution work.
niceToHave: Experience with CSR rules (Schedule VII) or government innovation schemes.
A network among Tamil Nadu's colleges or GCCs.

title: Data and Research Analyst, Founder Ledger
summary: Keep the public Founder Ledger right every quarter, and build the TN Founder Report 2027 and StartNet's indices.
outcome: A Founder Ledger published every quarter on time, with every figure traceable to its source and every correction logged.
about:
Mission 1 Lakh is to nurture 1,00,000 founders in Tamil Nadu by March 2031, and we count it in public: the quarterly Founder Ledger, with a confidence tag on every figure and a log of what we corrected. The same data feeds the TN Founder Report 2027, sector reports and indices such as the Campus Innovation Index.

You will own that data, from collection to the published number.
responsibilities: Clean, reconcile and publish the quarterly Founder Ledger with its methodology and corrections log.
Combine StartNet X records with public data (DPIIT, AISHE, StartupTN) and founder surveys.
Analyse and write the data sections of the TN Founder Report 2027 and the sector reports.
Build and maintain the index methods and score them each edition.
Answer the team's questions with data, quickly and with the caveats stated.
requirements: Two or more years in data analysis, research or economics.
Strong SQL and spreadsheets; Python or R for analysis.
Careful with sources: you write down where every number comes from.
You can explain a finding in plain English to people who are not analysts.
niceToHave: Familiarity with India's startup or higher-education data.

title: Full-stack Engineer, StartNet X
location: Salem, or hybrid within Tamil Nadu
summary: Build StartNet X, the one platform every StartNet programme runs on: founder profiles, events, learning and partner dashboards.
outcome: Founders, institutions and partners use StartNet X every week, and every programme's records reach the Founder Ledger without manual work.
about:
StartNet X gives every founder one profile, from their first event to their first funding, and gives institutions, incubators, GCCs, investors and government a view of their own programmes. It also runs event registration, the Academy and the data behind the Founder Ledger.

You will build features end to end in a small team, and ship often.
responsibilities: Build product features across the stack: React front end, Node.js APIs and the database.
Integrate payments, sign-in, email and WhatsApp messaging.
Make the platform fast and usable on low-end phones, in Tamil and English.
Write tests, review code and keep the platform secure and reliable.
Work directly with programme teams to understand what they need.
requirements: Three or more years building production web applications.
Strong JavaScript or TypeScript, React and Node.js; good SQL.
You care about accessibility, performance and data privacy.
You can own a feature from the first conversation to production.
niceToHave: You have built for Indian users: UPI payments, multilingual content, slow networks.

title: Programme Associate, StartNet Women
summary: Run Women Circles in the districts and support founders through Rise Academy and HerCapital.
outcome: Women Circles meet every month in each of our districts, and the founders in them move on to Rise Academy and HerCapital.
about:
StartNet Women helps women build product and service companies and get them ready for investment, with formats that fit around real lives: Women Circles of twenty founders a month in each district, Rise Academy for the business side with a mentor, and HerCapital for the investment that is already there.

You will be the founders' first point of contact and keep the Circles running.
responsibilities: Organise monthly Women Circles: venue, founders, speakers and follow-ups.
Guide founders into Rise Academy and track their progress with their mentors.
Help prepare founders and their documents for HerCapital investor days.
Keep every founder's journey recorded in StartNet X.
Collect stories, with consent, for StartNet's reports and site.
requirements: One to three years in community, programme or customer-facing work.
Fluent Tamil and good English, spoken and written.
Warm, organised and reliable: founders trust you to follow up.
Ready to travel within Tamil Nadu.
niceToHave: Experience with women's self-help groups, MSMEs or entrepreneurship programmes.

title: Content and Community Associate (Tamil and English)
summary: Tell StartNet's story in Tamil and English: event recaps, founder stories, the newsletter and our social channels.
outcome: Every StartNet event gets a recap within a week, and our newsletter and channels grow with founders who show up to the next one.
about:
StartNet works in Tamil and English, and our pages, recaps and reports must read well in both. We publish event recaps, founder stories, a newsletter and a podcast, and we hold everything we publish to an evidence standard.

You will write and edit, cover events, and keep our community talking with us between events.
responsibilities: Write event recaps and founder stories, with photos and consent in place.
Edit the newsletter and plan the social calendar for each brand.
Review the Tamil versions of site pages and posts with native fluency.
Cover events: photos, short videos and live posts.
Answer questions from the community, and pass on what you hear to the teams.
requirements: Excellent written Tamil and English, with samples to show.
One to three years in content, journalism or community management.
You check facts and you name your sources.
Comfortable with a phone camera and simple video editing.
niceToHave: Interest in startups, technology or education.
